pyongyang-2016.notes: Source 1 gives the event as 9 and 10 November (지난 11월 9일과 10일) without saying which day the contest ran; the catalogue has 2016-11-10. Source 1 links the problem set (inter_21_problems.pdf Korean, inter_21_problems_e.pdf English) and the standings image (inter_21_standing.png) on ryongnamsan.edu.kp; these are candidates for capture from the Wayback Machine. The QOJ page (source 3) was captured while logged in.

sources.evidence: Kim Il Sung University news page headed '김일성종합대학이 제41차 국제대학생프로그람 아시아평양지역경연을 주최', dated 2016-11-12, reporting the contest held at the university on 9 and 10 November.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a QOJ login form; our copy has since been replaced and is now the contest's dashboard with its problem list.
sources.evidence: QOJ contest dashboard headed 'The 2016 ACM-ICPC Asia Pyongyang Regional Contest' with a table of 12 problems numbered 1 to 12.
